thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Dedicated pool 'dedicated-eu-1' -> sustained error spike (5xx) and p90 latency increase. Error rate 12% over 5m. Paging oncall-engineer(s).

sara: acked — I'm on it. starting diagnostics now.

sara: checking autoscale history; I'm seeing repeated provisioning failures: `quotaExceeded: cores-per-project` in cloud logs.

mike: /incident ack. Any known customer-facing errors yet?

support-ops: Support ping: acme-inc reporting 500s on generate calls, ~2% of their traffic failing. Ticket #12345.

jia: If autoscaler can't provision we can toggle the reserved-burst. Command ready: `infra burst-toggle --pool dedicated-eu-1 --enable --reason \"hotsurge 1765432100\"`.

sara: before enabling, can we apply a short-term per-customer concurrency cap for non-enterprise traffic to relieve strain? Suggest `rate-limit set --pool dedicated-eu-1 --scope non-enterprise --concurrency 4`. Will that break any streaming?

mike: long-lived streaming could be impacted. If we can, remove experimental structured-stream route on dedicated pools: `router disable-route --name structured-stream --env dedicated`. That should free KV cache pins.

anova: I'll apply a traffic-shape policy to favor enterprise customers: `qos apply --pool dedicated-eu-1 --policy shaped-enterprise-first`. This will lower consumption for smaller tiers.

sara: ok doing a quick pre-check, then I'll flip the burst-toggle.

ops-bot: Running: `infra burst-toggle --pool dedicated-eu-1 --enable` — queued.

ops-bot: Result: success. Burst toggle enabled. Provisioning new burst instances (ETA ~45s).

mike: provisioning events visible in infra logs, new instances scheduled.

support-ops: Notified Acme support: \"We're applying mitigations (burst toggle + rate shaping). ETA ~2m to see improvement.\"

jia: Also pushing a targeted quota bump for enterprise customers only: `quota adjust --pool dedicated-eu-1 --selector enterprise_* --tokens +20%` — that keeps VIPs stable.

riley: Can someone set a global soft RPS cap to reduce burstiness? `rate-limit set --global --rps 50` — temporary.

sara: applied: `rate-limit set --global --rps 50` — confirmed.

ops-bot: Autoscale notice: added 6 burst instances to dedicated-eu-1. Capacity effective immediately.

mike: monitoring metrics — error rate falling to 1.1%, p90 latency down to 480ms.

support-ops: Acme confirms their 500s dropped to near zero in last minute.

anova: leaving structured-stream disabled for now. Will re-evaluate in 30m and coordinate re-enable if stable.

sara: prepping handoff notes: runbook link: https://acme.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0421-03 (brief: burst toggled, global ratecap 50rps, enterprise quota +20%, structured-stream disabled). Handing off to @jia in 10m.

jia: ack. I'll watch for 1h and handle rollback when safe. Please paste any customer threads into the incident doc.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0421-03 — severity: high -> mitigations applied: burst-toggle, qos-shape, global ratecap, structured-stream disable.

mike: small follow-up — we should file a short postmortem on why autoscaler hit quotaExceeded; tagging infra-team.

sara: noted. adding to the incident doc and assigning to infra-owner @marta.

support-ops: Closing customer-facing loop: Acme updated, internal ticket linked.

jia: taking over monitoring. if things regress I'll escalate.

sara: thanks team — leaving the channel. :thumbsup:
